limitations: HML counterpart segments are schematic where OSM only maps one track; wye second connector includes an inferred diamond crossing. Exact turnout and crossover engineering is not verified.
New flyover deck display is 165 m CGVD2013, with smooth terrain approach transitions. This is an illustrative vertical profile; no survey-derived height is claimed.
Port Credit below-grade track descent is schematic and intentionally obscured by the terrain surface; the route locator remains available.

The unchanged physical representations use display slope caps to avoid bare-earth DTM bridge dips (GO 3.5%, HML 6%, bus 8%). These are schematic profile constraints, not surveyed or approved engineering grades.
GTFS route shapes are service paths. GO individual rails use City 2024 photogrammetric Railway lines and do not assert which track every scheduled train uses.
Transitway is existing. The Erin Mills–City Centre link includes highway and street running; no continuous dedicated busway is claimed.
Station markers are geographic locators, not new station architectural models. City Centre and North Service locators are approximate and carry explicit coordinate tolerances.

The displayed 403 guideway envelopes use mapped paired bridge track positions with 2 m outer margins from each track centre and 1 m structural depth. Deck width/depth are illustrative, and no unverified pier positions are added.

Continuous coloured service guides are cartographic overlays raised above actual visible context when necessary. Their elevations, smooth display approaches and widths are not engineering values; underlying physicalPoints and physical meshes are preserved. Below-grade service remains legible without claiming tracks were moved to the surface.

verticalDatumExplanation: The schematic 403 flyover deck is displayed at 165 m above CGVD2013 (model Y=95 m after subtracting the 70 m origin). 165 m is an elevation, NOT bridge length. No surveyed engineering deck elevation was located.

visibilityGuide.method: Upper continuous display profile above actual overlapping render + interactive ground, road, park, woodland, bridge, platform-display and mapped-landscape triangles. Route positions resampled at maximum 3 m spacing, with both guide edges checked; shared nodes share height. Narrow surface peaks detected by the independent 1 m centre-and-edge audit add local clearance constraints. An 8% visualization slope limit gently approaches surface changes.
visibilityGuide.viewerDepthPolicy: service-guide nodes are unlit cartographic overlays: depthTest=false, depthWrite=false, renderOrder=100. Normal scene occlusion still applies to separate physical tracks.
visibilityGuide.renderFraming: Use full-city system files for expanded composition cameras; interactive district files are clipped to their actual browsing windows.
visibilityGuide.scopeCaveat: Context-surface clearance is validated separately from buildings and illustrative tree crowns. Overlay depth policy keeps mapped subgrade/tunnel service paths legible in the browser without asserting new aboveground engineering.

physicalTrackColourPolicy: Neutral grey. Semantic system colour appears only on separate unlit cartographic service guides.
